# --graph --json maps each target to all of its dependencies, including
# ordering-only ones and pre targets.
bit --graph --json app setup
cp stdout graph.json
exec jq -e '. == {"setup": [], "lib": ["setup"], "docs": ["setup"], "app": ["docs", "lib", "setup"]}' graph.json

# A planned graph has no JSON form.
! bit --plan --graph --json app
! stdout .

-- BUILD.bit --
pre setup = exec { command = "true" }
lib = exec { command = "true" }
docs = exec { command = "true" }
app = exec {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [lib]
  after = [docs]
}
